title: Audit direct callers of European tilemap origin readers
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI via Wine
changes: Account for all 162 signed direct Thumb calls to the six tilemap origin readers. The six additional calls reuse authenticated stream pointers within the existing bank.
validation: Wine 4us_dpy7 pins the six added instruction windows and checks the complete branch census against E457 and E458. All 18 protected inputs passed and Wine drained.
limitations: Direct source arguments only. Indirect calls, live index bounds, ordinary use, integration, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open.
